description: Delete a file from your personal Canvas storage. Cannot be undone. Get file_id from list_my_files. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

file_id.description: File ID (numeric string). Get it from list_course_files, list_my_files or list_group_files.

name: delete_my_file
title: Delete My File
